description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Search open federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov notices, presented as cards. Uses the same stored-notice engine as search_open_notices - one call, one search - with results sorted by posted date or deadline, not by a match score. Each card shows deadlines, the filter that matched it (e.g. the NAICS or set-aside you passed), and source links. Present as information only; not a bid recommendation. Every record carries a direct source link so you can verify and cite the underlying record. For a known current or previous solicitation/reference number, use solicitation_number; for a SAM notice ID use notice_id. These exact lookups include stored closed/archived records, do not inherit the browsing set-aside default, and do not search award contract PIIDs. Stored records are not a complete live-source or version-history search. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use.

solicitation_number.description: Exact current/previous solicitation or reference number; case, spaces and hyphens normalized. Includes stored closed notices. Omit browsing filters. Not an award PIID.
solicitation_number.title: Solicitation Number
